directOffers.note: Own SÜC AC network. Official AC price is 0.45 EUR/kWh for standard and fast AC. Standard-site blocking starts minute 121; fast-AC site blocking differs and is deliberately not generalized here.

dcDeferred.reason: SÜC publishes DC prices by charger power class and different blocking thresholds. Do not attach a single DC fallback until runtime/site power-band scoping is proven for every SÜC site.

roamingDeferred.reason: External SÜC charging-card tariffs are eMSP roaming prices and must not be attached to third-party physical CPOs.

note: Official SÜC own-network tariff currently served on the operator site. AC is safe as a direct own-network offer; DC remains power-tier scoped.
